prose: Short note from feed metadata only: the New York Times (Emmy Martin) reports on how San Francisco's AI boom is reshaping dating - founders treating first dates as interviews, tracking 'conversion rates,' and paying dating coaches $5,000 a month, as the boom draws a wave of young, ambitious, mostly male newcomers to the city. The source is paywalled, so the reporting beyond the synopsis is unverified.
